title: Three-Pulse Cadence: Priority Dossier and All-Hands Slate (v0-1)
content:
Purpose:
This dossier is a working artifact to align leadership and teams on a three-pulse quarterly cadence (30/60/90) that stitches OKR drafts, an exec update narrative, and the all-hands program for the next quarter. Goal: reduce ambiguity, signal hard bets, and leave room for tactical shifts.

High-level framing (one sentence):
Run a tight, visible cadence where decisions are surfaced every 30 days, with a single prioritized ask per function for the company all-hands.

Audience: exec team, product & eng leads, GTM leads, people ops owners.

Summary timeline (working):
- Pulse 0 (planning): Nov 3–17 — finalize OKR candidates and risk matrix, draft all-hands slate
- Pulse 1 (focus): Nov 18–Dec 15 — first 30-day sprint, surface early metrics; exec update on Dec 2
- Pulse 2 (course-correct): Dec 16–Jan 14 — adjust rollouts, prep deeper comms; mid-pulse review Jan 6
- Pulse 3 (finish/rollup): Jan 15–Feb 14 — finalize results, prepare next-quarter handoff, all-hands + exec summary Feb 7

Executive asks (explicit):
1) Approve the 3 top cross-company priorities for the quarter (see OKR draft below).
2) Greenlight the all-hands format: 45m scripted updates + 20m breakout Q&A + 10m rapid ops signals.
3) Commit a single stretch funding ask (2 FTEs in infra or equivalent budget) to be decided by Nov 17.

OKR draft (working, per the three-pulse lens):
Objective A — Make inference performance predictable and cheaper for paying workloads
- KR A1: Decrease hosted API 95th-percentile latency for 1–8k token requests from 420ms -> 370ms (client-visible).
- KR A2: Reduce hosted per-token cost on top-10 customers by 12% through batching & cache policies.
- KR A3: Ship automated rollout policy for fallback model routing with 99.5% success rate during constrained windows.

Objective B — Delivery and reliability: Raise baseline SLA posture for Dedicated and Private customers
- KR B1: Achieve 99.95% uptime for Dedicated clusters for two consecutive 30-day windows.
- KR B2: Codify and test Private deployment install runbook end-to-end (install -> smoke -> workload) on two customer profiles.
- KR B3: Reduce incident-to-ack time median from 6m -> 3m across infra/SRE rotations.

Objective C — Developer velocity and adoption
- KR C1: Decrease time-to-first-successful-inference (signup -> sample inference) from median 12m -> 6m in self-serve flow.
- KR C2: Publish three new quickstart templates (chat, retrieval-augmented, embeddings) with telemetry.
- KR C3: Reach 30% of trial accounts hitting 100k tokens/month.

Notes on scope and measurement:
- Metrics definition doc: hosted-api/perf-defs (link above).
- All KRs should be measured in-month (30-day windows) to support three-pulse feedback loops.

All-hands slate (draft program):
- Opening (5m): CEO signal and one-line company focus.
- Signals (15m): 3 cross-company updates (product safety, infra resilience, go-to-market traction) — each 4–5m with 1 slide and one measurable.
- Deep dive (10m): Serving runtime optimization story + demo (why P95 dropped).
- Customer vignette (5m): Short prerecorded customer highlight (Dedicated customer).
- Breakouts (20m): Functional breakouts (eng, product, GTM, ops) with one actionable ask per group. Breakout hosts: leads listed below.
- Rapid ops (5m): Risk table and how to signal incidents during holiday window.

Hosts & roles for all-hands: 
- Host/MC: Elena Rodriguez (company comms)
- CEO signal: Jordan Lee
- Infra & runtime update: Samir Patel (serving-runtime lead)
- Product/roadmap: Maya Singh (product-hosted-api)
- Customer vignette coordination: Laila Cho (CS)

Pre-flight checklist (before finalizing slate):
- Confirm customer vignette legal sign-off (owner: Laila) — due Nov 10.
- Slide deck skeleton in shared drive by Nov 12 (owner: Elena).
- Rehearsal #1 (exec run-through) Nov 24; Rehearsal #2 (with breakout leads) Dec 1.
- Rehearsal artifacts: speaker prompts, timing script, backup Q&A list.

Communication plan (external/internal):
- Internal: all-hands + follow-up one-pager with 3 tactical asks for team leads.
- External: condensed exec-summary for customers & press (if any) to be reviewed by comms/legal.

Risk register (top 6):
1) Capacity cliff during holiday peak (mitigation: pre-allocated burst pools; owner: infra).
2) Regressions after rollout (mitigation: canary + automatic fallback; owner: serving-runtime).
3) Incomplete Private install runbook (mitigation: concierge test; owner: solutions-eng).
4) Messaging misalignment on cost changes to customers (mitigation: GTM pre-brief; owner: growth).
5) Rehearsal no-shows (mitigation: backup speakers; owner: Elena).
6) Missing instrumentation for KRs (mitigation: telemetry sprint; owner: observability).

Decision log (open items):
- Funding ask: infra vs product — need exec call by Nov 17. (pro/con notes below).
- All-hands cadence: monthly pulse vs quarterly — prod & ops recommend monthly mini-pulse with major quarterly deep dive.
- Customer invite list for vignette: CS to propose 3, execs to pick 1 by Nov 12.

Working tensions (notes to leadership):
- Trade: speed vs reliability. We should prioritize predictable reclaimable performance over chasing headroom for peak-only customers.
- Trade: centralized decisions (exec) vs team autonomy. Recommend explicit delegation for one tactical mid-pulse pivot per function.

Operational asks (concrete):
- Infra: reserve 10% burst capacity for holiday window; report cost estimate by Nov 10.
- Serving runtime: complete KV-cache rollout test and report top-10 request traces by Nov 14.
- Product: finalize quickstart templates and add telemetry hooks by Nov 20.
- GTM: finalize customer comms draft and pricing language for batching changes by Nov 20.

Appendix: quick rehearsal script (condensed)
- MC opens (30s). CEO signal (90s). Three signals (3 x 3m). Deep dive demo (6m). Vignette (3m). Breakouts brief (5m). Rapid ops (2m). Close (1m).

Unresolved questions (for next sync):
- Do we want to surface cost per-token reductions publicly in the all-hands or keep it internal per-customer?
- Which two customer profiles should be used for Private runbook validation?
- If budget ask denied, which priority downgrades do we accept?

Slack references and tickets (working):
- #leadership-sync (thread: Nov 2 planning), #infra-ops (burst-capacity convo), JIRA-OPS-2145 (OKR telemetry).

Immediate next steps (this week):
- Owners to confirm acceptance of owners and due dates in this doc by Nov 7.
- Exec decision on funding ask by Nov 17.
- Deck skeleton and rehearsal schedule published by Nov 12.

Notes-to-self (informal):
- Keep the all-hands tight and rehearsed. No more than 6 slides maximum for the signal section.
- Push measurement to 30d windows; if teams can only report monthly, surface a simplified delta.

Contact for questions: Avery Chen (avery.chen@redwood.ai)

End of working dossier (v0-1).
